title: Four-Way Stop: Who Goes First?
intro: You and the blue car stop together. The gray car arrives later.
watchCaption: You and the blue car stop together; the gray car arrives later.
safeCaption: Blue goes first. You check, then proceed.
unsafeCaption: The blue car is coming from your right. Let it go first.
safeFeedback: When two cars stop together, yield to the car on your right. Blue goes, then you; gray arrived later.

feedback.go-first: Blue was on your right. When you stop together, blue goes first—even when both cars are going straight.
